categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: manufacturing of rubber and plastic synthetic leather products including raincoat fabrics, automotive parts, and inflatable products; warehousing and logistics services with a focus on rental and management of logistics centers; and real estate development including residential, commercial buildings, and industrial properties.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies in rubber and plastic synthetic leather production, including patented methods for protective clothing fabrics and low-temperature resistant rubber composite sheets. It utilizes equipment and materials optimization to enhance product performance, reliability, and safety, and integrates TPU and Drop-Stitch technologies for inflatable products. The company also emphasizes ISO 14001 environmental management and continuous R&D with a dedicated team of 10 researchers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in medical, industrial safety, electronics, automotive, and environmental sectors. The logistics segment serves well-known electronic distributors, luxury goods, apparel, and e-commerce companies. Real estate customers are mainly end-users and investors in prime urban locations in Taiwan and the US, including commercial tenants like banks and securities firms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with significant sales in Asia, Europe, and North America. It has a US subsidiary involved in real estate development in San Francisco and logistics facilities in Taoyuan, Taiwan, with expansion plans in Taoyuan Longtan and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment as a manufacturer of synthetic rubber and plastic materials, supplying downstream processors and end-product manufacturers. It also operates downstream in warehousing, logistics services, and real estate development, providing integrated solutions to clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation in product performance and new market applications, internationalization through global marketing and talent development, and service enhancement via diversified technical support. R&D focuses on new materials and products for defense, medical, industrial, and environmental applications, with ongoing patent development and investment in green building and smart logistics facilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of synthetic rubber and plastic materials, rental income from warehousing and logistics facilities, and sales and leasing of real estate properties. The company also earns income from service contracts related to logistics management and technical support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as Taiwan's largest manufacturer of rubber, plastic, and green synthetic leather products with a competitive edge in patented technologies and product quality. It competes with advanced manufacturers primarily from Europe, the US, and Japan, focusing on high entry barriers through innovation and exclusive patents.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.48 billion in 2024, representing an 8.94% increase from the previous year, with a net profit growth of over 10%. Total assets reached NT$15.13 billion, with steady growth in retained earnings and equity. The company maintains a mature lifecycle with stable profitability and ongoing capital investments in logistics and real estate.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, patented, and innovative synthetic rubber and plastic products tailored for specialized applications such as medical, safety, and environmental uses. It offers one-stop shopping with integrated product lines and customized logistics solutions, supported by strong R&D capabilities and sustainable practices, differentiating itself as a reliable and technologically advanced supplier.
